content.question: Which statement about PCA and t-SNE is correct?
options: PCA is a linear technique, while t-SNE is non-linear.
PCA is non-linear, while t-SNE is linear.
Both PCA and t-SNE are non-linear techniques.
Both PCA and t-SNE are linear techniques.
content.answer: PCA is a linear technique, while t-SNE is non-linear.
